# Security

This repository holds research and small read-only scripts. It holds no funds, no keys and no service.

## What to report

A script that could send a transaction, a secret committed by mistake, a link that leads to something other than what it says, or a finding that exposes information it should not.

## How to reach me

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository (the Security tab) when it is switched on, or write to contact@realspap.com. Replies are best effort, with no promised delay.

## Findings about other people's contracts

A finding here is read from public chain data. When a reading shows a hole in a live contract that is still open, I tell the team first and publish later: a silence of 90 days at most, and I name nothing in this repository before then.
